g.text: Matched battery fitting: 100 slots per method and seed
Seeds 0, 1, 2. Solid: median; shading: seed min–max; faint: individual seeds. Failed simulations consume slots.
Each panel selects its own best metric. Aggregates require all seeds; curves stop at recorded coverage. One simulated target.
